_comment: Mobile test sharding for @qvac/audiogen-ggml. The mobile CI action runs ONLY the tests listed here. Local `npm run ios/android` in qvac-test-addon-mobile extracts the async functions from test/mobile/test.cjs directly and does not consume this file. testGenerateMusic and testLoadModels download the turbo-q4 ACE-Step GGUFs (~3 GB) from the registry on-device into <testDir>/models (a pre-side-loaded set there or in $AUDIOGEN_MODEL_DIR is used as-is). NOTE: the `ios` group is intentionally omitted while iOS is deferred (see the iOS note in integration-mobile-test-audiogen-ggml.yml / QVAC-22838); restore it alongside the iOS matrix row.
